title: Breakfast Salad
description: A bright Australian-inspired breakfast salad with crisp romaine, marinated feta, avocado, eggs, sprouts, and fresh herbs.

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.quantity: enough to cover feta, plus more for serving

steps.instruction: The day before serving, place the feta in a small airtight container with the garlic clove and cracked peppercorns.
Pour in enough olive oil to completely cover the feta, then refrigerate overnight.
Wash the romaine by swishing each lettuce heart in a bowl of very cold water to loosen dirt, then drain upside down.
Trim the white stem ends and gently separate the romaine leaves while keeping their natural shape intact.
Arrange the romaine hearts on serving plates.
Squeeze half a lemon over each lettuce heart.
Scoop chunks of avocado onto the salad.
Add the sprouts, cucumber pieces, hard-boiled egg halves, and about 6 chunks of marinated feta.
Season generously with flaky salt and black pepper.
Drizzle generously with olive oil, including over the eggs, cheese, and avocado.
Scatter the fresh herbs over the salad and serve with the remaining lemon halves.
Serve with warm sourdough toast if desired.
